entries.description: With some custom themes, the close button covered the ? button. They now always sit side by side.
The title and the buttons line up, and a divider now separates the header from the tabs, like in the trigger editor.

The first time you open Triggers, the trigger editor, Snipe History or Settings, a short tour shows you around. Skip it with Skip tutorial, replay it from the ? button at the top, or turn tours off in Settings, under Interface.
In the Triggers tab, click ⋯ and choose Delete all triggers. It asks first.
The default triggers now include Incinerator. Import the defaults again to get it.

entries.text: Default triggers are ready to use
entries.description: Every default trigger now comes with auto-join and notifications on. Only the trigger itself is off until you turn it on.

entries.text: Import defaults on an empty list
entries.description: With no triggers yet, Import default triggers adds them right away, without asking Add or Replace.
A Vencord update changed how toasts work, so SolRadar's messages, like "Trigger added!", stopped showing. They show again.

Experimental, off by default. Turn it on in Settings, under Reading messages, to catch people who post the link first and add the biome in an edit. Only edits made in the first minute count, and an edit that keeps the same biome never makes a second snipe.
An edit that contains one of these words, like "ended" or "over", is ignored, since people add them when the biome is over. Add or remove words in Settings, under Reading messages.
Turn on "Ignore edited messages" in a trigger's Filters so it only fires on new messages.

entries.text: Snipe History shows how long ago
entries.description: Each snipe shows how long ago it happened again, like "5m ago". Hover it to see the full date and time.

entries.text: Shorter "and N more" in filter lists
entries.description: The button under a long server, channel, user or role list now just says how many more there are. Click it to see them all.

The plugin now lives at github.com/masutty/solradar, and update checks use it. Links in About and Updates point there, and to SolRadar Helper. Nothing changes for you if you update with SolRadar Helper.

entries.text: Search servers, channels, users and roles by name
entries.description: Every server, channel, user and role list now has a search box. Type a name or paste an ID, then press Enter or click a result.
Each list shows 5 entries. Click "Show all" to see the rest in a window with its own search. Hover a name to see its ID, and click it to copy.

entries.text: Warnings for deleted servers, channels and roles
entries.description: Entries you left, that were deleted or that you can no longer see are marked in red, with a button to remove them all. Their last known name stays visible.
Find the role by name instead of pasting its ID and typing a label.

entries.text: Snipe History uses the full width
entries.description: Each snipe is one row. The result is a dot on the trigger icon (hover it for the name), with the time, reaction time and biome duration on the right.

A bar shows how long joining, checking the link and the biome check took. What happened has three views: Timeline, now with the time since the step before, a new Waterfall, and Raw with debug lines hidden by default.
Total is now Reaction time, and every timing explains itself on hover.
"Was this biome real?" has a Timed out option, so a misclick on Real or Fake can be undone.

entries.text: Snipe Debug follows the whole snipe
entries.description: The debug button on messages now shows if a message would be ignored, saved to History, or joined, and what would happen after. It also tells you when a trigger that's turned off would match. Switch between a checklist and a compact trace.
When a setting stops a snipe, a button next to it fixes that setting. Check Roblox PlaceID asks Roblox which game a link opens, and Copy report gives you a summary to paste when asking for help.

entries.text: Messages built with Discord's new layouts
entries.description: Bots that post with the new message layout (text blocks and buttons, no embed) are now read: their text can match triggers and links in their buttons are found. Needs Interpret embeds, which is on by default.
The trigger editor and snipe details have proper header spacing, and their dividers reach both edges of the window.
Pick-one buttons (Real or Fake, Timeline or Raw, trigger type) react on hover, and text boxes and the trigger editor menu use Discord's thin scrollbar.

entries.text: Turn triggers on and off from the list
entries.description: Click a trigger's icon to turn it on or off. Disabled triggers are now outlined and grey, with a Disabled tag.
Turn forwarding off for every trigger at once from the Forwarding block in Settings. Each trigger keeps its own setting for when you turn it back on.

entries.text: Reorder triggers by dragging the whole card
entries.description: Press anywhere on a trigger and drag it. A plain click still opens the editor.
Join, Notify and Forward now show when you hover a trigger, and the full description shows in a tooltip.

Each trigger in Stats is now a bar: longer means more snipes, and the colors show how many were real, bait or timed out. Hover a trigger for its full numbers, including how long its real biomes lasted.
Hover the dot next to a snipe to see how it ended.
Every tab has a new look, built to match Discord's own settings pages.
Settings are grouped into collapsible blocks that remember if they are open, with an overview of what is on at the top.
Something not working? Send your setup to the developer from the bottom of the Settings tab. Your Roblox token is never included.
Snipes are now a timeline grouped by day, colored by result. Search stays on top, and the filter and clear options moved into menus.
The details window shows the timing on top, the biome result, and what happened step by step. Switch to Raw to see the full log.
Turn Join, Notify and Forward on or off right from each trigger. Hover a button to see what it does.
The tabs are replaced by a side menu. Everything you need is in Essentials, and the optional sections show a dot when they are set up.

entries.text: Try your own messages in the match preview
entries.description: Type a message under the preview to check if your trigger would match it.

entries.text: Updates, Stats, Utilities and Developer tabs
entries.description: Cleaner layouts, with tooltips that explain each option.
New "By Server" and "By Trigger" charts show where your snipes are coming from at a glance. Hover a slice (or the legend) to see the exact count and its real/bait/timeout split.

entries.text: Right-click menu for Snipe History entries
entries.description: Quick actions on any entry: view details, jump to the message, copy the server link, join server, or remove it.
The new charts sit right below the overview cards, above the per-trigger list.
Hover a trigger to reveal a drag handle on the left and reorder by dragging. Disabled while any search or filter is active.
Replaced the right-click action on triggers with a menu with quick actions like enable/disable, duplicate, export, etc.
Reorder triggers with ▲▼ buttons instead of dragging them, for anyone who prefers it.
Disable to go back to right-click instantly toggling enabled/disabled instead of opening the context menu.
Force-kill a running macro right after joining a snipe, before it can detect the biome and send a false alert to your macro's webhook.
Pick a known macro to auto-fill its kill target (Maxstellar, FishSol, Coteab, J.JARAM, SolsScope), or choose Custom to set your own.
Confirms whether the configured process name or window title actually matches something running, before you rely on it during a live snipe.

entries.text: Trigger SafeExport shouldn't be exporting mentionRoles
A triggers.json file with default triggers
Reworked import trigger menu to handle default or file

entries.description: You still need to update manually through the installer, or via git. You can disable this in settings.
Hide every origin information from your snipes. You can disable this in settings.
